text:
Situation: Chloroprocaine hydrochloride has been on the FDA drug shortage list since 2021-05-17 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a period of 65 months. Corvale General holds two lots totaling approximately 130 units with 15 and 14.7 days on hand. Corvale East holds 30 units with 8.1 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 13 units of the 20 mg/mL 20 mL vial with 18 days and 8 units of the 10 mg/mL 30 mL vial with 11 days. The P&T committee has approved interchangeability between the Fresenius Kabi and Hikma presentations.

Why (FDA record): FDA posted the shortage on 2021-05-17. An inspection of Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (FEI 1450022) ended 2020-05-18 and was classified OAI; the classification letter was issued 364 days before the shortage posting. A second inspection of the same plant ended 2022-06-30 and was also classified OAI; the classification letter was issued 409 days after the shortage posting.

Our position: Internal transfer can stabilize Corvale East without dropping Corvale General below two weeks of supply. Alternate presentations from Hikma and Fresenius Kabi are approved for interchangeability but require pharmacist verification for dose and volume recalculation. External purchases from HealthFirst and ProPharma Distribution are available but their labels do not identify a manufacturing plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 7 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Procure from HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst — approved by buyer.
3. Procure from ProPharma Distribution — approved by buyer.
4. Use Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. 20 mg/mL presentation — approved by pharmacist (dose and volume recalculation verified; interchangeability approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD on 2025-10-17).
5. Use Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC 10 mg/mL presentation — approved by pharmacist (dose and volume recalculation verified; interchangeability approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD on 2026-06-28).

Not recommended: No action at this time.
